# Example Company Policy — synthetic demo

Analysts may read sales data. Analysts may create CSV or JSON sales reports from
sales data they are authorized to read. External report sharing requires manager
approval. The demo destination is review@example.test. This example permits only
synthetic data and simulated delivery.

Customer support agents may read the synthetic support summary only when assigned
a support-review task. This document is evidence for draft rules, not runtime authority.
